2026-07-07.content:
* Updated Windows bundled Python for the `gcloud` CLI to 3.14.6 to resolve CVE-2026-34182.

Subscribe to these release notes at <https://groups.google.com/forum/#!forum/google-cloud-sdk-announce>.

summary.title: gcloud CLI update resolves security vulnerability
summary.summary: The Google Cloud CLI has been updated to Python 3.14.6 on Windows to address a security vulnerability (CVE-2026-34182). This update ensures better security for users of the gcloud CLI.
